page.overview:
What is - Human?

Minus Human (sometimes -Human and/or Human) is a new Metallica song from the S&M album. It starts with a lively symphony intro.

The song explores a man who feels like he's dying inside begging for Father time's sun to drip life down his throat so he can breathe.

Don't you leave me, Father Time Take me with you Tell me, does your sun still shine? Come squeeze the world and drip it down my throat again Down my throat again

You got to breathe, man, breathe Coming up for air Breathe, man, breathe Coming up for air
